critical_code_review_comments: super_admin.py ai_usage_report: to_date filter uses `a.created_at <= $N` — if the caller passes only a date like '2026-01-15' (no time), rows created that day after 00:00 will be excluded. The frontend already appends 'T23:59:59' to work around this (SuperAdminAIUsage.js line 49), so end-to-end this is fine, but the API contract is slightly asymmetric: from_date is inclusive-start-of-day (implicit 00:00) but to_date must be caller-appended-with-time. Consider normalising server-side (e.g. append 'T23:59:59' when only a date is supplied) so any future API consumer doesn't hit the trap.

super_admin.py ai_usage_report: item LIMIT 200 is hardcoded with no pagination/next-cursor — for a super admin looking at a busy production instance this may silently truncate results. Consider adding an offset/cursor or at least surfacing 'truncated: true' when rowcount hits the limit.

SuperAdminAIUsage.js: fallback_only checkbox sends the query param as `fallback_only=true` (string). FastAPI's `bool` parser accepts 'true'/'1' etc, but sending `false` explicitly would still be truthy in some frameworks — current code only sends the param when true, so this is fine, but worth a comment.
